story.title: Razorpay Gets Shareholder Approval for Rs 2,700 Crore IPO as Fintech Bets on AI Amid Rising Losses
story.summary: Indian fintech giant Razorpay has secured shareholder approval to raise Rs 2,700 crore through an IPO, which will include an offer for sale component and a pre-IPO placement tranche. The company is positioning AI-driven payment infrastructure as a central growth narrative for its public market debut, even as it continues to report net losses amid intense competition in India's digital payments sector. A successful listing would be a major milestone for India's fintech ecosystem and would test public market appetite for loss-making AI-first fintech platforms.
